Frames any EO task as a verifiable problem solvable by an AI agent, eliminating manual recipe design.
Suggests that the framework is broadly applicable, utilizing labeled benchmarks, physical models, or sensor data for verification.

stories.title: Ukraine blindsided by Starlink throttling restrictions and intelligence gaps
stories.author: Christopher Miller
bullet_points: Ukrainian military operations faced connectivity issues due to Starlink throttling restrictions.

stories.title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
stories.author: Emilio Ferrara
bullet_points: Introduces 'ChunkAct,' a method to improve the efficiency of agentic robotics systems.
Addresses the computational bottleneck where LLM reasoning over the full interaction history makes robotic tasks expensive.
Proposes action chunking to reduce redundant LLM reasoning, enabling generalization without constant retraining.

stories.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
stories.author: Liang Chen
bullet_points: Introduces DoubtLess, a novel training-free decoding method for reasoning models.
Addresses the inefficiency of long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, which often uses excessive tokens.
Uses a smaller reasoning model to steer a larger one, avoiding the need for additional model training or heuristic limitations.

stories.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
stories.author: Liang Chen
bullet_points: Introduces 'DoubtLess,' a novel training-free decoding method for reasoning models.
Addresses the inefficiency of long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, which often generates unnecessary tokens.
Uses a smaller reasoning model to steer a larger model, avoiding the need for additional model training or accuracy-reducing heuristics.

stories.title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
stories.author: Emilio Ferrara
bullet_points: Addresses the efficiency bottleneck in agentic robotics where LLMs are used in the control loop.
Proposes 'ChunkAct' to reduce redundant LLM reasoning by chunking interaction history.
Aims to improve the generalization and efficiency of LLM-driven robotic agents without requiring full retraining.

stories.title: The Internet’s undersea backbone is slipping into the danger zone
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: The article discusses the growing risks facing the internet's undersea fiber optic cables.
The topic is highlighted by Elisabeth Braw's book, 'Undersea War'.
This points to increasing geopolitical and physical threats to global internet infrastructure.

stories.title: What Matters in Quality-Aware VLA Pretraining: A Benchmark and Empirical Study
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: The study investigates optimal methods (weighting, filtering, conditioning) for incorporating demonstration quality during Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pretraining.
It evaluates these methods across various reward definitions and label granularities using 5,000 naturally suboptimal human demonstrations.
The research provides empirical insights into how pretraining data size and quality tags impact downstream task fine-tuning and inference.

stories.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
stories.author: Yong Jae Lee
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of training long-horizon AI agents, which are crucial for autonomous, complex tasks.
Proposes a solution to the sparsity of rewards in long-horizon tasks by introducing 'Dense Progress Rewards'.
Aims to overcome limitations in open-source models by providing a scalable recipe for training on complex, long-duration tasks.

stories.title: AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards
stories.author: Chong Luo
bullet_points: AesCode addresses the limitation of current code generation models in handling spatial planning and aesthetic quality for visual artifacts.
The model aims to bridge the gap between code-based structure (editable, verifiable) and visual design quality (achieved by image generators).
It introduces a novel approach using decoupled cross-modal rewards to improve the generation of structured visual outputs like slides and dashboards.

stories.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: Introduces 'Hybrid Reasoning Agents' (HybridAgents) to overcome limitations in current LLM agents.
Addresses the gap between efficient, latent internal reasoning and the need for external, text-based interaction.
The architecture dynamically switches between latent reasoning and text-based interaction during a unified generation process.

stories.title: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
stories.author: Xia Ning
bullet_points: The paper addresses multi-objective molecular optimization, a key process in drug discovery.
It proposes a method (MFG) that uses multi-turn feedback to guide molecular modifications.
The research aims to improve upon existing LLM-based methods that lack explicit training for iterative feedback.

stories.title: LIBERO-RIG: A Hardware-Setup Robustness Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
stories.author: Matthew Tancik
bullet_points: Introduces LIBERO-RIG, a new benchmark designed to test the robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models.
The benchmark specifically perturbs only the physical hardware and setup of the robot (e.g., camera mounting, calibration drift, control rates).
This addresses a critical real-world challenge: ensuring robot policies generalize despite variations in deployment environments.

stories.title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
stories.author: Shangding Gu
bullet_points: The research proposes 'Physical Recursive Self-Improvement' (Physical RSI) for robots.
Physical RSI aims to allow robots to guide lasting updates to their capabilities and improvement procedures through physical experience.
Key challenges identified include noisy observations, continuous dynamics, and the cost/irreversibility of trials.

stories.title: What Matters in Quality-Aware VLA Pretraining: A Benchmark and Empirical Study
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: The paper investigates how to effectively incorporate demonstration quality during Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pretraining.
It empirically compares different methods (weighting, filtering, conditioning) using 5,000 suboptimal human demonstrations across 24 target tasks.
The research examines the impact of pretraining data size and the utility of quality tags during fine-tuning and inference.

stories.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
stories.author: Yong Jae Lee
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of training long-horizon AI agents capable of autonomous, multi-day tasks.
A key problem identified is the scarcity of training data and the sparsity of rewards in complex, long-running environments.
The paper introduces 'Tev' to scale these agentic environments using dense progress rewards to overcome sparse feedback.

stories.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: Introduces 'Hybrid Reasoning Agents' to overcome limitations in current LLM agents.
Addresses the gap between efficient internal 'latent reasoning' and external 'text-based interaction'.
The agents dynamically switch between latent reasoning and text generation within a unified process.

stories.title: Exact Topological Compliance: Generating Persistence-Equivalent Graphs
stories.author: Vikas Garg
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of generating graphs whose topological structure exactly matches a target descriptor (Persistence Diagram).
Current topology-aware generative models often only achieve approximate similarity using soft regularization.
The paper proposes two principled approaches to achieve exact topological compliance in graph generation.

stories.title: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
stories.author: Xia Ning
bullet_points: The research addresses multi-objective molecular optimization, a key challenge in drug discovery.
It focuses on developing methods that use iterative feedback to guide molecular modifications.
The work aims to improve upon existing LLM-based approaches by explicitly training them to leverage feedback.

stories.title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
stories.author: Shangding Gu
bullet_points: The research proposes 'Physical Recursive Self-Improvement' (Physical RSI) for robots.
Physical RSI aims to allow robots to autonomously guide lasting updates to their capabilities and improvement methods based on physical experience.
Key challenges addressed include noisy observations, continuous dynamics, and the high cost/irreversibility of physical trials.

stories.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
stories.author: Yong Jae Lee
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of training long-horizon AI agents capable of autonomous, multi-day tasks.
It tackles the scarcity of training data and the problem of sparse rewards common in complex, long-running tasks.
The proposed solution involves introducing 'Dense Progress Rewards' to better guide agent learning in these difficult environments.

stories.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
stories.author: Liang Chen
bullet_points: Introduces DoubtLess, a novel training-free decoding method for reasoning models.
Addresses the inefficiency of long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting by reducing token usage.
Uses a smaller reasoning model to steer a larger model without requiring additional training or complex heuristics.

stories.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: Introduces 'Hybrid Reasoning Agents' (HybridAgents) to address limitations in current LLM agents.
The core innovation is dynamically bridging latent internal reasoning with external text-based interaction.
Aims to enable agents to reason beyond human language while still operating through natural language interfaces.

stories.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
stories.author: Lei Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces OmniCompass, a new holistic benchmark designed to evaluate omni-modal video grounding and understanding.
Addresses the limitation of existing benchmarks which only cover partial dimensions of video understanding for MLLMs.
Defines two specific evaluation tracks within OmniCompass, including OmniCompass-VL, to systematically diagnose model capabilities.

stories.title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
stories.author: Zhihao Lin
bullet_points: Addresses the limitations of current LLM temperature sampling, which often uses fixed or heuristic global settings.
Introduces 'Scenario-Actor,' a new, simple, and interpretable framework for temperature selection.
The framework adapts LLM decoding based on an inferred understanding of the communicative scenario.

stories.title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
stories.author: Jitin Singla
bullet_points: The paper explores leveraging moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data for machine translation.
It proposes that back-translation (BT), a technique from the pre-LLM era, is more effective than continued pretraining for this task.
The research addresses the limitations of standard few-shot prompting and fine-tuning when parallel data is scarce.

stories.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
stories.author: Yifei Shen
bullet_points: Introduces a 'Self-Evolving Agent Harness' that allows agents to revise their software scaffolding (prompts, memory, workflows, code) without retraining the underlying model weights.
Formalizes a feedback-driven process where accepted software revisions persist across different operational runs.
The framework provides granular control, separating updates to interpreted state from structural revisions to tools, code, and plugin composition.

stories.title: ASML's strong orders ease fears AI spending boom is running out of steam
stories.author: tartoran
bullet_points: ASML's strong order book suggests continued demand for advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
The news addresses market concerns regarding a potential slowdown or saturation in AI spending.

stories.author: arybka
bullet_points: Focuses on the evolution of AI beyond simple prompting for enterprise use.
